Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The orchestrator’s initial interpretation and fact sheet were off-target. It guessed the landmark building might be Willis Tower / Skidmore, Owings & Merrill without first identifying the APOD city, and later it kept steering the search into repeated scrolling loops instead of quickly resolving the APOD date and city. That premature assumption led the conversation toward the wrong city/building chain and ultimately to the wrong final answer.
